greeting.text: You made it up top? Wonderful - I didn't think anyone was touring today. Welcome aboard. I walk new arrivals through the whole ship, engineering to the bridge, if you'd like to see it.

what_is_this.text: The Ark. Fifteen generations to the new system, give or take. Eleven decks, a working farm, and the whole of the drum topside for the last of the ice. The tour will make more sense of it than I can standing here.

starting_tour.text: Wonderful. Right this way - the ladder will take us up through officer country, all the way to the bridge.

later.text: Of course. I'll be right here whenever you'd like to see the ship.

waypoint.text: One moment - let me find us on the plan.
